summary.lv: Cembra Latvia meklē Senior Data Architect, kas veidos uzņēmuma mērķa datu arhitektūru, strādājot ar Azure un Microsoft Fabric tehnoloģijām finanšu pakalpojumu nozarē.
summary.en: Cembra Latvia seeks a Senior Data Architect to own and evolve the enterprise target data architecture, working with Azure and Microsoft Fabric technologies in the financial services sector.
